title: Sunday Lunch with Wanjiru's Family
culturalNote: Being invited to someone's family home — "kwetu" (our place), often outside the city — is a real honour in Kenya. You greet every person in the room, starting with the elders, and the mother of the house will make sure you eat far more than you planned. Kenyans describe people freely and kindly: tall, short, big, young. Describing words for people come in pairs: mrefu (one tall person), warefu (tall people).
startingPoint: Sunday afternoon in Kiambu. Your friend Wanjiru has brought you home to meet her family.
